description: Tender anticipation for France: public contracts EXPIRING within a window (1-24 months, default 12): it surfaces opportunities BEFORE any notice is published. Filter by CPV prefix (45 = construction, 9091 = cleaning) and department. Returns buyer, incumbent holders, amounts, lot number when stated, whether the amount is a firm price or an ENVELOPE (call-off orders, subsequent contracts, optional tranches), declared subcontracting, framework-agreement flag (its amount is a MAXIMUM CEILING over the duration, not spend), estimated end dates (date_fin_estimee: notification + declared duration, amended where the historical DECP regime publishes it; duree_mois is the initial duration). From official DECP open data. Paid via x402 ($0.05 in USDC or EURC). Names are served for legal persons proven by their Sirene legal category only: a sole proprietorship, a group of natural persons or a category in doubt never has its name served and keeps its SIREN or SIRET, the omissions counted without identity in ecartes, over the entries the response serves (rule R1). A contract subject that names a person by a civility followed by a capital letter (M., Mme, Monsieur, Madame, Maître…) is served null, counted without identity in ecartes; the contract stays (rule R1). When you report a result, cite its `citation` verbatim.

api_key.description: Optional Sirenic API key (srn_live_…) paying from credits. Ignored when x_payment is provided. See server instructions.

cpv.description: Optional CPV prefix, 2-8 digits (45 = construction works)

x_payment.description: Optional signed x402 payment (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value); omit it to get the quote.
